arxiv-2210-15389.title: Stability and related zero viscosity limit of steady plane Poiseuille-Couette flows with no-slip boundary condition
arxiv-2210-15389.creator: Song Jiang Chunhui Zhou, [4mm] Department of Mathematics, Southeast University, Nanjing, 210096, China. Email: zhouchunhui@seu.edu.cn
arxiv-2210-15389.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Song Jiang Chunhui Zhou, [4mm] Department of Mathematics, Southeast University, Nanjing, 210096, China. Email: zhouchunhui@seu.edu.cn. We prove the existence and stability of smooth solutions to the steady Navier-Stokes equations near plane Poiseuille-Couette flow. Consequently, we also provide the zero viscosity limit of the 2D steady Navier-Stokes equations to the steady Euler equations. First, in the absence of any external force, we prove that there exist smooth solutions to the steady Navier-Stokes equations which are stable under infinitesimal perturbations of plane Poiseuille-Couette flow.

arxiv-2505-10651.title: Evolution imposes an inductive bias that alters and accelerates learning dynamics
arxiv-2505-10651.creator: Benjamin Midler, Alejandro Pan Vazquez
arxiv-2505-10651.description: Abstract The learning dynamics of biological brains and artificial neural networks are of interest to both neuroscience and machine learning. A key difference between them is that neural networks are often trained from a randomly initialized state whereas each brain is the product of generations of evolutionary optimization, yielding innate structures that enable few-shot learning and inbuilt reflexes.

pmc-12658138.title: Versatile on-chip plasmonic lattices enabled by Kekulé metasurfaces
pmc-12658138.creator: Jinguo Liu, Yufan Luo, Airong Zhao, Pin Lyu, Ying Liu, Wenhui Sun, Xiaofan Wang, Chaoling Du, Mingming Jiang, Caixia Kan, Shuiyan Cao, Yanpeng Liu
pmc-12658138.description: Surface plasmon polaritons (SPPs) lattices created by artificial plasmonic metasurfaces, can carry tremendous optical information and have implications for resilient and secure optical communication. However, tailoring the intensity, spectral, and spatial distributions of these SPP lattices intentionally remain challenging. Here, we develop, theoretically and experimentally, a variety of optical SPP lattices in a category of metasurface named as Kekulé metasurface.

pmc-13587729.title: Chronic high-fat diet feeding reduces the rate of postprandial triglyceride absorption independent of intestinal ANGPTL4
pmc-13587729.creator: Shwetha K. Shetty, Kelli L. Sylvers-Davie, Brandon S.J. Davies
pmc-13587729.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Pancreatic lipase is the major enzyme responsible for breaking down dietary triglycerides in the intestines. A previous report suggested that intestinal angiopoietin-like 4 (ANGPTL4) might serve as an endogenous inhibitor of pancreatic lipase and thus regulate fat absorption. As Angptl4 expression is reportedly induced by high-fat-diet feeding, we hypothesized that induction of ANGPTL4 by a high-fat diet would lead to an increased inhibition of pancreatic lipase, less breakdown of dietary triglycerides, and ultimately a reduced rate of postprandial triglyceride absorption.
